name: GreenThumb Site Visits
description:
This dataset contains records from site visits and inspections of community gardens, with one row per inspection. Each record identifies the garden by a park ID and inspection ID and describes the site's physical features and amenities. These include fence length, sidewalk area and length, water access (hydrants and rain harvesting, with collected gallons where reported), solar panels, compost systems and tumblers, food-growing and non-food planting areas, open lawn or communal space, paved areas, trees (fruit, street, and empty tree pits), murals, sheds, park signs, chickens, ponds and fish, turtles, aquaponics, greenhouses, and season-extension structures. Several fields also flag programs and activities such as farmers markets, CSA pickups, and composting. Most columns are true/false indicators, while a few are numeric measurements; some fields, notably rain gallons and fish in pond, are missing for many records.

The data can be used to assess garden infrastructure and resource needs, compare sustainability features
